acceptance.given: The Package B handoff table is available for authoring or update, with the five in-scope Skills and their migration context defined by the Package A requirements.

oracle.expected: The handoff table records an accepted quality contract and CLI for each of the five Skills, documents legacy behavior and expected migration touchpoints, preserves existing authority and optional Bootstrap Review status, and does not make Package A completion depend on migrating or passing the five real Skills.
forbidden: Any of the five Skills lacks an accepted CLI entry.
Legacy behavior or expected migration touchpoints are omitted.
The table requires the five real Skills to pass the new standard or enables an internal reviewer.
Excluded BMAD, GDS, or Chapter 2-7 Skills are included in Package A scope.
oracle.observable: During contract or terminal validation, an artifact check parses the Package B handoff table and verifies five complete Skill rows, accepted CLI fields, legacy and migration fields, authority and Bootstrap Review status, plus the stated Package A exclusions.

acceptance.then: The accepted CLI for all five Skills is recorded in the Package B handoff table with the required compatibility, authority, and scope information.
acceptance.when: During the A25 artifact and terminal validation phase, inspect the authored Package B handoff table and its surrounding standard handoff guidance.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_migration.py::test_a25 verifies the Package B handoff artifact and fails with an AssertionError when any required Skill row, accepted CLI, legacy behavior, migration touchpoint, authority/status preservation, or exclusion statement is absent or incorrect.

affected_subjects: accepted CLI for the five Skills
slice_hint.behavior_change: Document the accepted Package B CLI handoff and migration boundary for all five Skills while preserving existing authority and optional Bootstrap Review status.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Removing the A25 handoff section restores the pre-handoff documentation state; no runtime or schema data is changed.

slice_hint.state_transition: Package B handoff guidance moves from unrecorded to an artifact containing accepted CLI, compatibility, authority, and migration-boundary entries for five Skills.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The A25 migration test and whole-plan terminal validation observe one complete handoff table with five accepted CLI rows and all required boundary statements.
